title: IngestedDocument
description: Schema representing a structured, parsed procurement tender document across PDF, DOCX, and TXT formats.

document_id.description: Unique deterministic or UUID identifier for the ingested document.

filename.description: Original file name of the uploaded document.

file_type.description: Detected format of the source document.

extracted_text.description: Consolidated normalized text of the entire document across all pages.

character_count.description: Total character count of the consolidated text.

metadata.description: Optional file metadata such as file size, hash, or parser details.

pages.description: Ordered array of extracted pages preserving document layout boundaries.

PageObject.description: A single page representation with text and block locations.

text.description: Normalized text content of this page.

extraction_method.description: Method used to extract text for this page.

character_count.description: Character count of this page's text.

blocks.description: Extracted paragraphs, clauses, or text blocks with offset locations.

TextBlock.description: A discrete clause, heading, or paragraph within a page.

page_number.description: Page on which this block resides.

char_start.description: Character offset start on the page.

char_end.description: Character offset end on the page.
